// ============================================================================
// Node: 2. Query Builder & Safe Allowlist Dispatcher
// Purpose: Maps the validated intent to a strict, read-only SQL template.
//          The LLM NEVER generates raw SQL directly.
// ============================================================================
const item = $input.first().json;
const intent = item.classified_intent;
const params = item.params || {};

const queryCatalog = {
  overall_summary: {
    description: 'Overall executive business metrics (Revenue, Cost, Profit, AOV, Margin)',
    sql: `SELECT 
            COUNT(order_id) AS total_orders,
            SUM(quantity) AS total_units_sold,
            ROUND(SUM(sales), 2) AS total_revenue,
            ROUND(SUM(cost), 2) AS total_cost,
            ROUND(SUM(profit), 2) AS total_profit,
            ROUND((SUM(profit) / NULLIF(SUM(sales), 0)) * 100, 2) AS overall_profit_margin_pct,
            ROUND(AVG(sales), 2) AS average_order_value
          FROM ecommerce_sales;`
  },
  top_products: {
    description: 'Top 5 performing products ranked by total revenue',
    sql: `SELECT 
            product_name,
            category,
            COUNT(order_id) AS order_count,
            SUM(quantity) AS units_sold,
            ROUND(SUM(sales), 2) AS total_revenue,
            ROUND(SUM(profit), 2) AS total_profit,
            ROUND((SUM(profit) / NULLIF(SUM(sales), 0)) * 100, 2) AS profit_margin_pct
          FROM ecommerce_sales
          GROUP BY product_name, category
          ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
          LIMIT 5;`
  },
  underperforming_products: {
    description: 'Underperforming products with lowest or negative profit margins',
    sql: `SELECT 
            product_name,
            category,
            SUM(quantity) AS units_sold,
            ROUND(SUM(sales), 2) AS total_revenue,
            ROUND(SUM(profit), 2) AS total_profit,
            ROUND((SUM(profit) / NULLIF(SUM(sales), 0)) * 100, 2) AS profit_margin_pct
          FROM ecommerce_sales
          GROUP BY product_name, category
          ORDER BY total_profit ASC
          LIMIT 5;`
  },
  category_performance: {
    description: 'Revenue, profit, and volume breakdown by product category',
    sql: `SELECT 
            category,
            COUNT(order_id) AS total_orders,
            SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity,
            ROUND(SUM(sales), 2) AS total_revenue,
            ROUND(SUM(profit), 2) AS total_profit,
            ROUND((SUM(profit) / NULLIF(SUM(sales), 0)) * 100, 2) AS profit_margin_pct
          FROM ecommerce_sales
          GROUP BY category
          ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;`
  },
  city_performance: {
    description: 'Geographic revenue and profit breakdown by city',
    sql: `SELECT 
            city,
            COUNT(order_id) AS total_orders,
            ROUND(SUM(sales), 2) AS total_revenue,
            ROUND(SUM(profit), 2) AS total_profit,
            ROUND((SUM(profit) / NULLIF(SUM(sales), 0)) * 100, 2) AS profit_margin_pct
          FROM ecommerce_sales
          GROUP BY city
          ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;`
  },
  monthly_trend: {
    description: 'Monthly revenue, profit trends and Month-over-Month (MoM) growth %',
    sql: `WITH monthly_metrics AS (
            SELECT 
              TO_CHAR(order_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS sales_month,
              COUNT(order_id) AS order_count,
              ROUND(SUM(sales), 2) AS monthly_revenue,
              ROUND(SUM(profit), 2) AS monthly_profit
            FROM ecommerce_sales
            GROUP BY TO_CHAR(order_date, 'YYYY-MM')
          )
          SELECT 
            sales_month,
            order_count,
            monthly_revenue,
            monthly_profit,
            ROUND(
              ((monthly_revenue - LAG(monthly_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY sales_month)) 
              / NULLIF(LAG(monthly_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY sales_month), 0)) * 100, 
              2
            ) AS mom_revenue_growth_pct
          FROM monthly_metrics
          ORDER BY sales_month ASC;`
  },
  anomaly_detection: {
    description: 'Statistical anomaly detection flagging months with significant deviation',
    sql: `WITH monthly_agg AS (
            SELECT 
              TO_CHAR(order_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS sales_month,
              ROUND(SUM(sales), 2) AS monthly_revenue,
              ROUND(SUM(profit), 2) AS monthly_profit
            FROM ecommerce_sales
            GROUP BY TO_CHAR(order_date, 'YYYY-MM')
          ),
          baseline AS (
            SELECT 
              ROUND(AVG(monthly_revenue), 2) AS avg_monthly_revenue,
              ROUND(STDDEV(monthly_revenue), 2) AS std_monthly_revenue
            FROM monthly_agg
          )
          SELECT 
            m.sales_month,
            m.monthly_revenue,
            m.monthly_profit,
            b.avg_monthly_revenue,
            ROUND(((m.monthly_revenue - b.avg_monthly_revenue) / b.avg_monthly_revenue) * 100, 2) AS deviation_from_avg_pct,
            CASE 
              WHEN m.monthly_revenue > (b.avg_monthly_revenue + 0.5 * b.std_monthly_revenue) THEN 'HIGH_OUTLIER'
              WHEN m.monthly_revenue < (b.avg_monthly_revenue - 0.5 * b.std_monthly_revenue) THEN 'LOW_OUTLIER'
              ELSE 'NORMAL'
            END AS anomaly_flag
          FROM monthly_agg m
          CROSS JOIN baseline b
          ORDER BY m.sales_month;`
  }
};

const selected = queryCatalog[intent] || queryCatalog['overall_summary'];

return [{
  json: {
    question: item.question,
    intent: intent,
    description: selected.description,
    sql_query: selected.sql,
    params: params
  }
}];
